name: Old Medina
hero_subtitle: A compact, working medina of food stalls, spice shops and everyday Casablanca life — quieter than Marrakech or Fez.

overview.title: Small, Authentic, Still Lived-In
overview.p1: Casablanca’s Old Medina is much smaller than those of Marrakech or Fez. It is a dense tangle of lanes where residents shop for vegetables, spices and household goods. Tourist-oriented stalls exist, but the overall atmosphere is local rather than staged.
overview.p2: It sits close to the port and the city centre, so it is easy to combine with Rick’s Café, the Marché Central or a walk toward the Corniche. Keep an eye on your belongings as you would in any busy urban market.
overview.p3: Do not expect the architectural drama of imperial medinas. Come for a slice of ordinary Casablanca life, a cheap snack and a sense of the city’s older layers before the Art Deco boom.

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting the Old Medina

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Short walk or taxi from the centre and port area. Easy to combine with Rick’s Café.

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Morning is best when the market lanes are most active.

3.title: Safety
3.desc: Use normal big-city awareness; keep bags closed and phones secure in crowded stretches.

q1.question: Is the Old Medina free?
q1.answer: Yes. There is no ticket to walk the streets.

q2.question: How does it compare to Marrakech?
q2.answer: Much smaller and less monumental. More everyday shopping, less spectacle.

q3.question: How long should I spend?
q3.answer: One to two hours is enough for most visitors.

q4.question: Is it safe?
q4.answer: Generally fine by day with normal precautions. Stay aware in crowded spots.

q5.question: What should I combine it with?
q5.answer: Rick’s Café, Marché Central, or a taxi to the Corniche and Hassan II Mosque.

food.title: What to Eat in the Old Medina
food.p1: The Old Medina has simple food stalls and small eateries. Choose busy places and keep expectations modest.
food.li1: Grilled skewers and simple sandwiches from busy stalls.
food.li2: Fresh juices and mint tea from small cafés.
food.li3: Pastries and bread from local bakeries.
food.li4: Spice and olive stalls if you are shopping.
food.li5: A short taxi to Rick’s Café or the Corniche for a full meal.
food.p2: Check prices before you order. For a structured meal, leave the medina.

page.intro: Explore Old Medina, a captivating destination offering unforgettable landscapes, historical heritage, and rich cultural experiences in Morocco.

content.hero_subtitle: Discover the authentic charm and unique experiences of Old Medina.
content.sec1_text: Located in one of Morocco's most picturesque regions, Old Medina offers visitors an immersive journey into rich heritage, stunning architecture, and warm local hospitality.
content.sec2_text: Whether you are exploring historical sites, tasting traditional Moroccan flavors, or discovering surrounding natural landscapes, Old Medina provides memorable moments for every traveler.
content.sec3_text: To make the most of your visit to Old Medina, plan your itinerary during optimal seasons, connect with certified local guides, and experience authentic local accommodations.
